name: Fever
note: Live-entertainment discovery and ticketing tech platform, co-founded and led by Ignacio Bachiller, Francisco Hein and Alexandre Perez (Fever newsroom, 17 September 2026). Its September 2026 $250 million round was led by EQT with participation from Point72 Private Investments, Baillie Gifford and other unnamed existing investors (same release); no single controlling owner is named in its releases.
